summary: Retractable Technologies filed an 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce its second-quarter and first-half 2026 results via a press release. The release details net sales of $7.2M for Q2 2026 versus $10.4M in Q2 2025, an operating loss of $5.1M, and a net income of $2.8M including a $6.4M gain on sale of equity securities. No special-situation event such as acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present—only routine earnings disclosure, so the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
